Access records are retained for up to 2 years. Data Access Reports can be requested for a property. These data access records include GA UI Reporting, GA UI Explorations, GA Data API, and other products like Firebase & Admob that can retrieve data from Google Analytics through a linkage. These records don't include property configuration changes like adding a stream or changing a property's time zone.
